attributes.action: Make all Geo engineering and atmospheric chemical release illegal in the UK.
attributes.additional_details:
This petition asks the UK Government to ban atmospheric geoengineering and weather modification over UK skies. Geo engineering involves spraying chemical particles into the upper atmosphere to block sunlight, a practice often referred to as "chemtrails."
This petition addresses major risks to public health, unpredictable weather changes, and damage to crops.
It demands a legally binding ban on these experiments to protect our environment and ensure no trials happen without public consent.
attributes.background: Ban as of immediate effect: The intentional release, injection, or dispersion of chemical aerosols into the atmosphere—often referred to as 'chemtrails' or stratospheric aerosol injection—posing significant risks to public health, air quality, natural ecosystems, agriculture, and weather stability.
